reviewMetrics.metricCaveat: This is a source-register cleanup metric, not a completeness score for the country fiche. A field is complete only when each material claim has traceable evidence at an appropriate level of specificity.

currentRows.title: CIA World Factbook – Democratic Republic of the Congo
currentRows.reason: The row has no URL or dated edition. The CIA retired The World Factbook on 2026-02-04, and the former country URL now redirects to the retirement notice. It cannot act as a live current-country citation.
currentRows.replacementPolicy: Replace only the specific claims previously attributed to this row, using field-level sources.

currentRows.title: SIL Ethnologue – Languages of DRC
currentRows.reason: The row has no URL, edition, access date, or licensed extract. The current country product is licensed and cannot be treated as a reproducible open inventory without a precise edition and reuse basis.
currentRows.replacementPolicy: Use the pinned Glottolog inventory for reconciliation. Cite Ethnologue only if a licensed, versioned citation is later supplied and its reuse terms are respected.

currentRows.title: Recensements nationaux congolais
currentRows.reason: The row does not identify a census, publication, institution, or URL. Official planning documentation states that the latest completed national census dates from 1984; it cannot support a current people denominator.
currentRows.replacementPolicy: Use the Ministry source for census status and the DHS catalogue for sample-survey context only. Neither is an exhaustive contemporary people inventory.

currentRows.title: ONU – Données démographiques 2025
currentRows.reason: The row is vague and duplicates the existing exact UNFPA 2025 country-dashboard citation.
currentRows.replacementPolicy: Retain the exact UNFPA source already present in the country fiche.

currentRows.title: Études anthropologiques sur les peuples congolais
currentRows.reason: A generic body of studies cannot validate an inventory, identity, population share, or cultural statement.
currentRows.replacementPolicy: Use these sources only for their declared scope, and add fiche-specific scholarly sources for each people record.

currentRows.title: Études historiques sur les royaumes précoloniaux
currentRows.reason: The row is not a resolvable citation. The dedicated history proposal contains a reviewed registry of exact institutional and scholarly sources.
currentRows.replacementPolicy: Use the complete source registry in COD-history.json when individual historical claims are approved.

currentRows.title: Ethnologie du Congo
currentRows.reason: The title has no author, edition, publisher, date, page, or URL and is too broad to support any individual field.
currentRows.replacementPolicy: Add exact field-level sources during people-fiche review instead of introducing another umbrella citation.

currentRows.title: CIA World Factbook – Democratic Republic of the Congo (ethnic groups)
currentRows.reason: The row has no dated edition or URL, and the source has been retired. Broad ethnic-group summaries would not validate the detailed percentages currently stored in the country fiche.
currentRows.replacementPolicy: Do not publish detailed people percentages as validated until a traceable denominator and compatible classification are documented.

proposedSources.caveat: The inventory includes language entries associated with the country. It does not by itself determine official status, current vitality, speaker population, or which scope the public count should expose.

proposedSources.title: Constitution of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as revised in 2011
proposedSources.publisher: Presidency of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
proposedSources.scope: constitutional country name and language roles
proposedSources.caveat: Article 1 distinguishes French as the official language and Kikongo, Lingala, Swahili, and Tshiluba as national languages.

proposedSources.publisher: Ministry of Planning and Strategic Development Coordination, Democratic Republic of the Congo
proposedSources.caveat: The page describes the planned second census and identifies 1984 as the first census. It is not a current ethnic or people census result.

proposedSources.title: Democratic Republic of Congo — Demographic and Health Survey 2013–2014
proposedSources.caveat: This is a sample survey, not an exhaustive census or canonical people inventory.

proposedSources.title: Country Technical Note on Indigenous Peoples' Issues: Democratic Republic of the Congo
proposedSources.publisher: International Fund for Agricultural Development and International Work Group for Indigenous Affairs
proposedSources.scope: Indigenous peoples terminology and approximate contextual counts
proposedSources.caveat: The source addresses Indigenous peoples issues and must not be generalized into an exhaustive inventory of every people in the country.

proposedSources.title: The Indigenous World 2024: Democratic Republic of the Congo
proposedSources.publisher: International Work Group for Indigenous Affairs
proposedSources.scope: current thematic context on Indigenous peoples
proposedSources.caveat: This is a thematic subset and not a national ethnolinguistic census.

proposedSources.title: Les recherches linguistiques au Congo belge
proposedSources.caveat: The 1954 colonial-era classification is historical evidence only. It must not be treated as a contemporary identity inventory or copied without critical reconciliation.
